observed_guarantees: Selected one-shard scan verifies contiguous header and projection spans and binds full-file plus individual expert hashes.
Canonical separately supplied manifest pin, copied identity, metadata/header/stat and implementation identities checked before read.
Read fetches only three bounded spans and verifies payload digests even if a stat guard misses corruption.
No network, MLX, GPU, decoder, scale interpretation or active runtime mutation.
limitations: Synthetic fixture tests only; no actual window14 payload or serving arithmetic qualification.
Full-file identity captured during bind, not rehashed on each selected expert read; other rows are outside per-read integrity scope.
Local pinned identities provide consistency, not authenticated upstream provenance.
Requires a single uniform projection bank with complete contiguous coverage; mixed/ragged shards are intentionally unsupported.
